evidence.note: requeue is assigned error.retryable && attemptCount < config.maxAttempts after NonNegativeInt increment; requeue true is unreachable unless retryable is true at every producer (Box DmsMirrorUnavailable at 1107 and VaultScanFailed retryable:false at 1118).

notes: Legal tuples: retryable-false/requeue-false (non-retryable fail), retryable-true/requeue-true (attemptCount after +1 still < maxAttempts; default PosInt 3, enqueue/revive start at 0), retryable-true/requeue-false (budget exhausted; documented layerConfig maxAttempts PosInt 1 makes 1<1 false on first fail). 01 is unrepresentable. Readers at 1056-1059 write existing SyncOperationStatus queued|failed and mark the item error only on !requeue; do not persist this pair. retryable stays independent on DmsMirrorUnavailable. Reuse queued|failed directly; no new persisted boolean and no cross-product with disconnectReason or the leased|succeeded statuses.
